subpackages.description: System to administer web accounts - Qt6 bindings
System to administer web accounts - Qt6 bindings - devel package

kaccounts-providers.install:
%cmake_install

# Presumably unused config files (no reference in any related source project)
rm -rfv %(installroot)/etc/signon-ui
rmdir -v %(installroot)/etc

kbd.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-euro2-Use-the-euro-sign.patch

# Give keymaps that clash with another basename unique names, and expose the
# Colemak layout as "colemak" rather than upstream's "en-latin9"
# https://github.com/aerynOS/recipes/issues/2866
# https://bugs.archlinux.org/task/13837
mv data/keymaps/i386/qwertz/cz{,-qwertz}.map
mv data/keymaps/i386/olpc/es{,-olpc}.map
mv data/keymaps/i386/olpc/pt{,-olpc}.map
mv data/keymaps/i386/fgGIod/trf{,-fgGIod}.map
mv data/keymaps/i386/colemak/{en-latin9,colemak}.map

# TODO: This now supports zstd compression (dlopening the shared lib). Switch to that (requires changes to the kernel recipes)
%configure \
    --datadir=%(datadir)/kbd
kbd.check:
# Skip libcommon-test03: it needs a Linux console when stdin is a tty.
%make check </dev/null

kdeconnect.setup:
# We may need WITH_X11=ON for xwayland, but for now we're trying without it so as to avoid packaging libfakekey
%cmake_kf6 \
    -DWITH_X11=OFF

kdeplasma-addons.environment:
# Uses a cargo crate (qmk-via-api) which breaks the build if built with LTO
export RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS/ -C lto=fat/}"

keepassxc.check:
# C locale fails https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepassxc/issues/11813
env LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 %cmake_test -E testcli

# version script assignment of 'KEYUTILS_1.7' to symbol 'keyctl_restrict' failed: symbol not defined
export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -Wl,--undefined-version"

for i in %(installroot)%(datadir)/icons/*/; do

kget.check:

kitty.install:

cp -r linux-package/. %(installroot)%(prefix)

_build/bin/kitten __complete__ setup bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/kitty

kmod.setup:
# On Aeryn we compress kernel modules with zstd. Users may use
# lzma/zlib so build support for those but use dlopen() if necessary
%meson \
    -Ddlopen=xz,zlib

subpackages.description: Library files for %(name), typically pulled in as a dependency of another package.
Terminfo for %(name), split out so that it can be used from ncurses

krb5.setup:
# Make sure that all scripts are ran with Bash. Dash seems to segfault
find . \( -type d -name .git -prune \) -o -type f -print0 | xargs -0 sed -i \
    -e 's|#!/bin/sh|#!/usr/bin/bash|g' \
    -e 's|#! /bin/sh|#! /usr/bin/bash|g' \
    -e 's|SHELL=/bin/sh|SHELL=/usr/bin/bash|g'

%patch %(pkgdir)/ftbfs-openssl-4.patch -p2

%configure \
    --disable-rpath \
    --enable-dns-for-realm \
    --with-ldap \
    --with-readline \
    --with-system-et \
    --with-system-ss \
    ac_cv_path_SH="/usr/bin/bash"

subpackages.description: Various text handling addons - Qt6 bindings
Various text handling addons - Qt6 bindings - Devel files

kubectl.build:
hack/update-generated-docs.sh
%make kubectl

# Build completions
_output/bin/kubectl completion bash > kubectl-bash-completion
_output/bin/kubectl completion fish > kubectl-fish-completion
_output/bin/kubectl completion zsh > kubectl-zsh-completion
kubectl.install:
%install_file docs/man/man1/kubectl* -t %(installroot)%(mandir)/man1
%install_exe _output/bin/kubectl %(installroot)%(bindir)/kubectl

# Install completion scripts
%install_file kubectl-bash-completion %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/kubectl
%install_file kubectl-fish-completion %(installroot)%(fishcompletionsdir)/kubectl.fish
%install_file kubectl-zsh-completion %(installroot)%(zshcompletionsdir)/_kubectl
kubectl.environment:
export CGO_CFLAGS="${CFLAGS}"
export CGO_CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS}"
export CGO_LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS}"

# NOTE: -mod=readonly in GOFLAGS breaks the build
export GOFLAGS="-buildmode=pie -ldflags=-linkmode=external -ldflags=-compressdwarf=false -modcacherw"
# NOTE: this also ensures the binaries have full RELRO
export GOLDFLAGS="-linkmode=external -compressdwarf=false"

# Otherwise this will try to download the upstream golang toolchain
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local

kwin.install:
%cmake_install

rm -rfv %(installroot)%(docdir)
